positive_snippets:
Had an excellent stay at Hotel Blackberry. One of the best hotels in Faridabad with a perfect location in the heart of the city. It is just about 100 meters from Old Faridabad Metro Station, making travel very convenient.

The rooms are very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Room service is quick and professional. Another big advantage is the huge parking space, which is very helpful for guests traveling by car.

Hotel blackberry is nice and staff very polite
Location is easily u can reach from metro station rooms are so nice go and enjoy the moment
